Helus Pharma has completed enrollment in its Phase 3 APPROACH pivotal study of HLP003 for the adjunctive treatment of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). The study enrolled 223 adults with moderate to severe MDD who experienced inadequate response despite a stable antidepressant regimen. This milestone advances the company toward the expected release of topline data in the fourth quarter of 2026.

HLP003 is an investigational deuterated psilocin analogue that has received Breakthrough Therapy Designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Participants in the randomized, double-blind study were assigned 1:1 to receive HLP003 (16 mg) or placebo, with doses administered three weeks apart.
The primary endpoint is the change from baseline in the Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) at six weeks after the first dose compared to placebo.

## Clinical Development Program

The APPROACH study is part of the broader Phase 3 PARADIGM Program, which incorporates key considerations outlined in the FDA’s recently finalized guidance. These include rigorous placebo-controlled evaluation, measures to support the interpretability of study results, and defined safety monitoring. The program also collects longer-term safety, durability, and redosing data through the EXTEND study.
